summary.zh: 建立 design token、组件文档与响应式规范
summary.en: Build design tokens, component docs and responsive scales

description.zh: 从 design token 到组件文档和响应式尺度，搭起一套可交付的设计系统。适合新产品统一视觉语言，或需要把设计规范交接给开发时使用。
description.en: Builds a design system from tokens through component docs, responsive scales and developer handoff. Use it to unify a visual language across a product or to prepare specs for engineering.
